verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document enabling or disabling Copilot agents per organization, group, or instance. It also does not document allow, ask, or deny policies for agent tool use. The only nearby items are adjacent: individual-account Copilot settings (github-docs-53), fine-grained PAT permissions, and the 'Ask'/'Agent' mode dropdown, which is a chat mode rather than a governance policy. None of these earns credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can enable or disable AI agents per group or instance and set allow, ask, or deny policies for the tools they can use
